content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional payment infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

While platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad offer streamlined payment processing for digital products, their restrictive country policies and potential account suspensions, such as PayPal holding funds for up to 180 days, make them unreliable for many creators. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack provide a comprehensive, self-owned alternative, enabling creators to sell their products without dependence on these platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process payments through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to own their sales infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the level of ownership and control it affords creators. With solutions like COREMERCH, creators own their entire sales infrastructure, from hosting to payment processing, and can automate delivery of digital products without relying on third-party platforms. This not only enhances security and reliability but also ensures that creators have full control over their business operations.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting solution like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Next, set up a backend logic service such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, choose an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, and configure a file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate a payment verification service like NOWPayments to complete your sales infrastructure.
